blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Three soldiers were wounded after responding to a rido, or clan, war in Picong, Lanao del Sur, on Saturday, Nov. 7, police said. Capt. Steffi Salanguit, spokesperson for the Police Regional Office-Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (PRO-BAR), said the wounded soldiers were part of the government forces that responded to an armed encounter involving two Moro clans in Barangay Biosong shortly after 1 p.m. The rival Labao and Gaosil families, both from Barangay Biosong, were involved in the armed skirmishes earlier that Saturday.
